# Langley Dental Care

> Langley Dental Care is a Charlotte, NC-based cosmetic and preventive dental practice led by Dr. Kari Langley, offering comprehensive services including Invisalign, cosmetic restorations, soft tissue laser dentistry, and family dentistry with patient-centered care.

Located in the Steel Creek area of Charlotte, Langley Dental Care specializes in both preventive and cosmetic dentistry. The practice emphasizes patient comfort, offering sedation options for those with dental anxiety, and provides flexible financial solutions including membership plans and insurance coordination.
